description: RF burst watch: lock-and-log duty-cycle timing on one frequency (Phase 8)

description: Opt-in cross-session watchlist: flag addresses you have seen before (Phase 9)
steps: Settings Watchlist OFF/ON - the app's only persistent-identity feature and strictly opt-in: never persisted, so OFF is the factory state on every launch and OFF means zero file reads, zero writes, zero RAM use

watchlist.txt (/ext/apps_data/room_sweep/): read once per enable, appended one 'aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff,label' line per flag, 16-entry RAM ceiling with a WATCH FULL notice; tolerates CR, spaces, blank lines and # comments so it stays hand-editable; malformed/overlong lines are refused whole
Flagging is manual: Hold UP on a Wi-Fi or BLE detail page labels the row with its SSID/name (23 chars) or 'flagged'

Matching on Wi/BLE upserts: right-edge WATCH badge on list and detail rows (coexisting with ? hints and the ! rogue mark via a tested ui_layout chain), ON WATCHLIST / flagged: session N on the detail page, and an all-or-nothing watch=1 token in the 48-byte CSV observation detail
Room Report: 'Watchlist matches: N' plus the honesty line naming it the only persistent-identity feature and stating a matching address is not proof of the same physical device
room_sweep_watchlist.h (Flipper-free parse/match/list, integer math) + tests/test_watchlist.c; raw MACs live only in watchlist.txt, session CSVs keep per-session ordinals

description: Two device-found recorder defects: identity-map saturation and the baseline burst (session-17/18)
steps: Found on device, invisible to the host suite: a baseline snapshot enqueued 20 events in one tick into an 8-slot queue and lost 9 rows (record_queue_full); the 32-slot per-session identity map saturated (20 RF labels + 10 APs + 13 BLE + system ids) so later rows came out id=REDACTED, including phase 8's WATCH rows

Fixes: the baseline handler drains in small groups as it enqueues; the map is 64 entries; the burst watch writes a LITERAL WATCH id that spends no map slot and refuses any mismatch rather than coercing (a MAC can never reach the id column that way)
Re-verified on device (session-18.csv): 20/20 baseline rows, 32/32 WATCH rows with id=WATCH, zero REDACTED rows, 174 watch=1 rows
tests/test_record_state.c +9 cases pin the literal-vs-identity split, the refusal path and the map sizing
